title: cli test: serve-multi-node-gate-declaration's test-budget 58 s is off the 10 s grid, so every timings refresh's regression diff refuses
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: the refusal printed in PR #34314's body (`## Regression readings: NOT MEASURED -- the diff refused`), which the body says owes a card; area `o2-C` confirms it still reproduces on `main` at `a34eb07`. Dedupe: `serve-multi-node-gate-declaration`, `test-budget 58`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:server

## 维护者速读

- 现象：`packages/cli/test/serve-multi-node-gate-declaration.integration.test.ts` 的耗时预算头写的是 58 秒，不在 10 秒刻度上，耗时刷新工具读到就拒绝，所以每次刷新都量不出回归读数。
- 为什么要修：回归读数是刷新 PR 判断有没有测试变慢的唯一依据，现在整份都是「没量」。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## Change

Set that file's `// test-budget:` header to a value on the 10 s grid, derived the way the header rule says (measured CI reading x 1.25, rounded up to the grid; ruling records 6181973363 and 6212133431), and check no other test file carries an off-grid budget.

## Done when

`scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`'s diff runs to the end on `main` without the refusal.
